1940年2月15日。下午译件。

《国民日报》、《大美报》、《新闻报》和《申报》于2月13日刊登了以下陶希圣从香港寄来的信件：——

五、局势与新政府。

新政府将在苛刻且虚伪的条件下建立。我们应清醒地认识到，即使日本的条款并不苛刻，新政府也将无法维持自身存在，且几乎不可能取得任何良好成果。

从日本的角度来看，新政府永远无法促成“中国事变”的终结。相反，它将证明是日本对列强及对华政策的巨大障碍；其建立对日本毫无益处。迟早，日本将抛弃“调整中日新关系之主要方针”以及新的中央政府。

我仍希望汪精卫、周佛海、梅思平等人能在悬崖边缘犹豫止步，并停止他们的一切活动。

pages.en:
February 15, 1940. Afternoon Translation.

National Herald, Ta Mei Pao, Sin Wan Pao and Shun Pao
published on February 13 the following letter from
Hongkong written by Tao Hsi-sen :-

WHAT IS THE "NEW CENTRAL GOVERNMENT"?

(Concluded from yesterday)

Now it may be assumed that Major-General
Kagesa must have been fully supporting the Wang Ching-
wei regime, but he does not seem to be prepared to commit
harakiri over the failure of the activities of the Wang
Ching-wei clique. To tell the truth, he is likewise making
preparations for a new course should his first prove
unsuccessful. He is now engaged in creating a Youths'
Corps to counteract the Wang Ching-wei clique. It will be
recalled that a certain official of the organ under his
control is now advocating support for the New League of
Chen Chung-fu (陈中孚) as a counter-measure against Wang
Ching-wei's movement. When asked the reason of this
support by Chow Vai-hai, Major-General Kagesa merely said
that he (probably the official in question) was a fool.
On another occasion he was asked by Chow why Lieutenant-
General Kita and Major-General Harada had instigated Wang
Keh-min and Liang Hung-tse to oppose the Central Political
Council, but he simply replied that they must have been
drunk. Unexpectedly, both Wang Ching-wei and Chow Vai-hai
believed what he said.

The various parties in Japan are looking for a
new course. The Japanese hope for an early termination of
the hostilities, but they are unwilling to abandon their
policy of aggression or their activities to subjugate China.
Consequently, the only course open to them is to enter into
negotiations with one whom they are supporting as the leading
political authority in China and with whom they can conclude
a peace pact fully in accordance with the wishes of the
Japanese warlords under the definition of the "Principal
measures for the readjustment of the new relations between
China and Japan." This is the only task the Japanese have
so far completed. What is most regrettable is that with
the completion of this task, Wang Ching-wei has lost his
political career and freedom.
pages.zh:
1940年2月15日。下午译件。

《国民日报》、《大美报》、《新闻报》及《申报》于2月13日刊载了以下陶希圣自香港发来的信件：——

何谓“新中央政府”？

（续昨日）

现可推断，影佐祯昭少将必定曾全力支持汪精卫政权，但他似乎并不打算因汪精卫一伙活动的失败而切腹谢罪。说实话，他也在为第一条路走不通时准备新的出路。他目前正着手组建一个青年团，以对抗汪精卫一伙。须记得，其控制下的机关中某位官员现在主张支持陈中孚的新联盟，作为对付汪精卫运动的对策。当周佛海询问支持此人的理由时，影佐少将仅称他（可能指该官员）是个傻瓜。另一次，周佛海问他为何北田利一中将和原田少将煽动王克敏和梁鸿志反对中央政治委员会，他只是回答说他们一定是喝醉了。出乎意料的是，汪精卫和周佛海都相信了他说的话。

日本各方正在寻找新的出路。日本人希望早日结束敌对状态，但他们不愿放弃其侵略政策或征服中国的活动。因此，他们唯一的出路是与他们扶持为中国主要政治权威的人进行谈判，并在“调整中日新关系之主要措施”的定义下，缔结一份完全符合日本军阀意愿的和平条约。这是日本人迄今为止唯一完成的任务。最令人遗憾的是，随着这项任务的完成，汪精卫已失去了他的政治生涯和自由。

pages.en:
February 14, 1940. Afternoon Translation.

National Herald, Ta Mei Pao, Sin Wan Pao and Shun Pao published
on February 13 the following letter from Hongkong written by
Ta Hsi-sen :-

WHAT IS THE "NEW CENTRAL GOVERNMENT"?

(Continued from yesterday)

III - Japan's Attitude vis-a-vis Wang Ching-wei's
Regime.

The establishment of a government under these
conditions will, of course, be detrimental to China, but it
will be equally disadvantageous to Japan for the following
reasons:-

Politically and diplomatically, there are only
two ways for Japan to deal with China, namely, (1) through
the complete subjugation of China and (2) through the
conclusion of a peace with China at an opportune time.

The first is impossible because the subjugation
of the whole of China will necessitate the stationing of
troops throughout the country from Heilungkiang in the north
to Hainan Island in the south and from the East China Sea to
Thibet in the west. This is obviously impossible for Japan
and is beyond her powers, but if she should succeed in doing
so, she would have nothing left and she would in no position
to compete with the Powers for supremacy.

Japan fully realizes that she is not in a
position to conquer China. She is now being pressed by her
people to terminate the China incident. The Japanese people
are anxious for an early settlement of the Sino-Japanese war.
They are now observing a very rigorous thrift so as to support
their government but the burden is becoming unbearable,
therefore they are longing for a settlement of the Sino-
Japanese hostilities prior to the conclusion of the European
war so that they can devote their energies towards the
expansion of their trade abroad. This tendency on the part of
the Japanese people has made some change in the outlook of
the Japanese Government. All the political parties, industrial
sections and the controlling authorities of the naval and
military forces in Japan have been influenced by this pressing
demand of their people.

The problem that is now facing them is whether
to carry on the war or to bring it to an end. Of course,
they all desire to end the hostilities. The Konoye statement
and other speeches are no longer being given serious attention
by the Japanese people who now understand whether or not the
Wang Ching-wei regime is capable of bringing about a
settlement of the China incident.

It is known to all that the Wang Ching-wei
regime is not in a position to enforce its orders amongst
the Chinese army. Then how can such a government enter into
negotiations with Japan for the conclusion of hostilities?
The Wang Ching-wei regime is not in a position to enable
Japan to despatch one Division less to China or to withdraw
one Brigade more from China; on the contrary it has become
an extra burden to the Japanese. The Japanese people, who
are thrifty, are already complaining of the squandering of
money by their government in financing the activities of the
Wang Ching-wei clique.
pages.zh:
1940年2月14日。下午译件。

《国民日报》、《大美报》、《新闻报》和《申报》于2月13日刊登了以下这封由大西森（Ta Hsi-sen，音译）从香港撰写的信件：——

什么是“新中央政府”？

（续昨日）

三、日本对汪精卫政权的态度。

在此种条件下建立政府，当然对中国不利，但出于以下原因，这对日本同样不利：——

在政治和外交上，日本对付中国只有两条路，即（1）通过彻底征服中国，以及（2）通过适时与中国达成和平。

第一条路是不可能的，因为征服整个中国需要在从北面的黑龙江到南面的海南岛，以及从东面的东海到西面的西藏的全国范围内驻扎军队。这对日本来说显然是不可能的，也超出了其能力范围；但如果它真的做到了，它将一无所有，也就没有地位与列强争夺霸权。

日本充分认识到，它无力征服中国。目前，日本民众正迫使政府终止“中国事变”。日本民众渴望早日解决中日战争。他们现在实行非常严格的节俭以支持政府，但负担已变得难以忍受，因此他们渴望在欧洲战争结束之前解决中日敌对状态，以便将精力投入到海外贸易的扩张上。日本民众的这种倾向使日本政府的看法发生了一些变化。日本的所有政党、工业界以及海陆军控制当局都受到了民众这一迫切要求的影响。

他们现在面临的问题是继续战争还是结束战争。当然，他们都希望结束敌对行动。近卫声明和其他演讲不再受到日本民众的认真关注，因为他们现在明白汪精卫政权是否有能力促成“中国事变”的解决。

众所周知，汪精卫政权无法在中国军队中强制执行其命令。那么，这样一个政府如何能与日本进行谈判以结束敌对行动呢？汪精卫政权无法使日本向中国少派遣一个师团或多从中国撤出一个旅；相反，它已成为日本的额外负担。崇尚节俭的日本民众已经在抱怨政府浪费金钱来资助汪精卫派系的活动。

pages.en:
February 14, 1940. Afternoon Translation.

Why have the Japanese been so kind as to accord such good treatment to Wang's clique? Simply because they hope that the Wang Ching-wei clique would be able to buy over the troops and influential persons to work for Japan, but all these attempts have ended in failure and a general strike---a strike originating from the re-awakening of the people---prevails amongst the members of the Wang Ching-wei clique, many of whom are deserting. How can a government, which is even unable to maintain itself, be able to bring about the termination of hostilities? The Japanese are not ignorant of the fact that the best way to support the new regime is for them to continue the hostilities. It was for this reason that between September and October last year a strong sentiment to the effect that Wang Ching-wei's regime was not necessary became prevalent among the Japanese people. Since January this year, the attitude of the Japanese newspapers towards Wang Ching-wei has undergone a radical change from a favourable to an unfavourable stand.

If Japan desires to continue the hostilities, she will have no use for the services of a puppet nor will it be necessary for her to set up a new Central Government. On the other hand, if Japan really desires to bring the hostilities to an end, puppets will be of no benefit to her; on the contrary, they will prove to be more of a handicap. The new Central Government cannot be more useful than the Provisional Government or the "Reformed Government." Thus, the Japanese militarists are in a dilemma as to how to deal with the new Central Government; they have already sounded the trumpet but they have found it inconvenient to continue their support of this government. This is why Wang Ching-wei and his followers are inactive in the Western District of Shanghai.

But, after all, why is General Itagaki's clique, especially Major-General Kagesa, so anxious to see Wang Ching-wei come into power? This is simply because as they have entered the arena, they want to carry on even if they have nothing to offer. They want to gain time. In case their efforts should prove detrimental to Japan's diplomacy or harmful to future prospects for peace, they will simply postpone the formal inauguration of the government. This explains why the date of the inauguration of the new Central Government has been postponed so often.

In the capacity of a director of the new regime, Major-General Kagesa naturally cannot order a postponement of the inauguration of the new government; therefore he requested Lieutenant-General Kita and Major-General Harada to instigate Wang Keh-min and Liang Hung-tse to raise obstructions. This is a fact known to all, except to Wang Ching-wei, Chow Vai-hai and Mei Shih-ping (梅思平).

With the exception of the members of General Itagaki's clique, all Japanese people realize that it would be useless for them to carry on any longer and that it would be better to seek another course if they desire to end the China incident. This has been regarded as necessary even by some members of General Itagaki's clique.
pages.zh:
1940年2月14日。下午译文。

日本人为何对汪派如此厚待？ simply 因为他们希望汪精卫集团能够收买军队及有影响力的人士为日本效力，但所有这些尝试均以失败告终，而且一场源于民众觉醒的总罢工在汪精卫集团成员中蔓延，其中许多人正在逃离。一个连自身都难以维持的政府，如何能够促成敌对行动的终止？日本人并非不知道，支持新政权最好的方式就是他们继续维持敌对状态。正因如此，去年九月至十月间，日本民众中盛行一种强烈的观点，认为汪精卫政权并无必要。自今年一月以来，日本报纸对汪精卫的态度发生了根本性转变，从支持转为反对。

如果日本希望继续敌对行动，它将无需傀儡的服务，也无需建立一个新的中央政府。另一方面，如果日本真的希望结束敌对行动，傀儡不仅无益，反而会成为更大的障碍。新的中央政府所能发挥的作用不会超过“临时政府”或“维新政府”。因此，日本军国主义者在如何处理新中央政府的问题上陷入了两难境地；他们虽然已经吹响了号角，却发现继续支持该政府令其处境尴尬。这就是为什么汪精卫及其追随者在上海西区无所作为的原因。

但是，究竟为何板垣征四郎将军一派，尤其是影佐祯昭少将，如此急于让汪精卫掌权？这仅仅是因为既然他们已经介入此事，即便没有什么可提供的筹码，也想硬撑下去。他们想要争取时间。万一他们的努力被证明对日本外交不利或有害于未来的和平前景，他们只需推迟政府的正式成立即可。这就解释了为何新中央政府的成立日期一再推迟。

身为新政权指导者的影佐祯昭少将自然不能下令推迟新政府的成立；因此，他请求北田丰中将和原田熊吉少将唆使王克敏和梁鸿志制造障碍。这是除汪精卫、周佛海和梅思平之外，众所周知的事实。

除了板垣征四郎将军一派的成员外，所有日本人都意识到，继续下去已无用处，如果他们希望解决中国事变，最好另寻他途。甚至连板垣将军一派中的某些成员也认为这是必要的。

pages.en:
February 14, 1940. Afternoon Translation.

The following statement was made by a certain
official who succeeded to the post left vacant by Major-
General Kagesa in the General Staff Headquarters:- "Whereas
it is easy to deal with the Wang Ching-wei clique as well
as the question of the new Central Government, it is
necessary to find some other means before we can reach a
fundamental solution of the China affair."
I was immediately informed of this statement
by a person who had overheard it, but I did not apprise
Wang Ching-wei of this because he is a man who does not
have a full comprehension of the psychology of the Japanese
people.

(To be continued)
pages.zh:
1940年2月14日。下午译文。

以下陈述由一位在总司令部接替影佐祯昭少将空缺职位的某官员作出：“虽然处理汪精卫派系以及新中央政府的问题较为容易，但在我们找到其他一些手段之前，尚无法从根本上解决中国事变。”

我立即从一位偶然听到该言论的人那里得知了这一陈述，但我并未将此告知汪精卫，因为他是一个未能充分理解日本国民心理的人。

（待续）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE

January 20, 1940.

TAIRIKU SHIMPO.

ITALY ADOPTS FRIENDLY ATTITUDE TOWARDS NEW CHINESE
REGIME ; PREMIER SENDS CONGRATULATORY TELEGRAM TO
WANG CHING WEI

It is reported that on January 9
the Foreign Minister of the Italian Government, acting on
instructions from Premier Mussolini, sent a telegram of
congratulations to Wang Ching Wei offering full support
for the new central government which he is forming.
On January 11 Wang Ching Wei sent
a telegram to the Italian Foreign Minister expressing his
appreciation and thanks for the congratulations and Italy's
friendly attitude.
The report submitted to Rome by
the Italian Ambassador to China dealing with the important
decision made by the Japanese Government regarding the new
central government to be formed in China is believed to
have been responsible for the issuing of the congratulatory
telegram which is regarded as an indication of the
recognition of the new regime by Italy.
According to information received
from reliable sources the national policy of Italy is to
recognize the new regime, therefore, it is believed that
Italy will recognize the new regime within one week of its
formation.
The Italian Ambassador to China is
now waiting to present his credentials to the new regime
with a view to exchanging Ambassadors between the two
countries. Germany, Spain, Hungary, Salvador and Thai
will follow Italy's example. Germany like Italy will
exchange Ambassadors with the New Chinese Government.
With the support of such friendly
Powers, the Wang Ching Wei Party is now actively engaged
in promoting international relations with Great Britain,
America and France.

FILE
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部登记处
编号 S. B. D. 8986
25 / 1 / 40

1940年1月20日。

《大陆新报》。

意大利对新中华政权采取友好态度；首相向汪精卫致贺电

据报，1月9日，意大利政府外交部长奉墨索里尼首相之命，向汪精卫发出贺电，对其正在组建的新中央政府表示全力支持。1月11日，汪精卫致电意大利外交部长，对意方的祝贺及意大利所表现的友好态度表示感谢与谢忱。

据信，意大利驻华大使向罗马提交的关于日本政府就将在中国组建的新中央政府所作重要决定的报告，促成了该贺电的发出，此举被视为意大利承认新政权的信号。

根据从可靠渠道获得的消息，意大利的国家政策是承认新政权，因此，人们相信意大利将在新政权成立后的一周内予以承认。

意大利驻华大使目前正等待向新政权递交国书，以期两国互派大使。德国、西班牙、匈牙利、萨尔瓦多和泰国将效仿意大利的做法。德国将像意大利一样，与新中华政府互派大使。

在这些友好列强的支持下，汪精卫派系目前正积极致力于促进与英国、美国和法国的国际关系。

档案

The report that Count Galeazzo
Ciano, Foreign Minister, had sent a
message wishing success to the pro-
posed new "Central Government" of
Mr. Wang Ching-wei was considered
here yesterday as perfectly in keeping
with the Fascist policy of being con-
stantly anti-Communist.
It was regarded as natural that Italy
should uneasily watch Russia's rapidly
growing influence on Generalissimo
Chiang Kai-shek, because of the
latter's increasing dependence on
Russian military support.
Authoritative sources pointed out
that Italy has been strengthening her
relations with Japan since the war
started. They drew attention to the
Japanese goodwill flight recently and
the exchange of friendly messages
between Italy and Japan.
It was noted that Count Ciano was
Italian Consul-General at Shanghai for
several years and was later Italian
Minister to China. It was understood
that he is personally acquainted with
both Generalissimo Chiang Kai-shek
and Mr. Wang Ching-wei.—United

1940年1月21日

齐亚诺向汪先生致意不足为奇
意大利政策鼓励反共行动

罗马，1月20日电。
据报外交大臣加莱阿佐·齐亚诺伯爵（Count Galeazzo Ciano）已发去讯息，祝愿汪精卫先生拟议中的新“中央政府”取得成功。昨日此处认为，此举完全符合法西斯主义一贯反共的政策。
人们认为，鉴于蒋介石总司令日益依赖俄罗斯的军事支持，意大利不安地注视着俄罗斯对蒋总司令迅速增长的影响力，这是自然而然的。
权威消息人士指出，自战争爆发以来，意大利一直在加强与日本的关系。他们提请注意近期日本的亲善飞行以及意日之间互换的友好讯息。
值得注意的是，齐亚诺伯爵曾担任驻上海意大利总领事数年，后任意大利驻华公使。据悉，他与蒋介石总司令和汪精卫先生均有私交。——合众社

SHANGHAI TIMES.
JAN 23 1940

Chen Chun-po Exposes
Hollow Character Of
Kao-Tao Allegations

Chief Of Wang's Secretariat Says Agreement Alleged
By Two Men Was Merely The Original Japanese
Demands And Not Terms Arrived At

KONOYE STATEMENT REMAINS GUIDING
PRINCIPLE, SAYS NIPPON SPOKESMAN

Mr. Chen Chun-po, Chief of Mr. Wang Ching-wei's Secretariat, interviewed yesterday morning by the China News Agency on the alleged agreement reported by Mr. Kao Tsung-wu and Mr. Tao Hsi-sheng to have been signed between Mr. Wang and Japan, stated that what was published were only the demands presented by the Japanese.

The Chinese counter-demands and the terms as actually arrived at between Mr. Wang's representatives and the Japanese representatives are completely ignored, either because Mr. Kao and Mr. Tao are ignorant of them or because they have deliberately withheld them as part of their bargain with the Chungking authorities.

The terms agreed upon, declared Mr. Chen, are certainly not detrimental to China's sovereignty and independence. The Chinese nation will soon realize that far from being a stranglehold on China's independence they will form the basis of co-existence and co-prosperity, between the two nations and lay the foundation of permanent peace in the Far East. The time has not yet come for the actual terms to be published, and until the terms are published, which incidentally require the concurrence of both parties to the negotiations, Mr. Chen said he appealed to the Chinese public to exercise patience and not to pay credence to rumour-mongers and paid trouble-makers.

Konoye Statement
The statement of Prince Ayamaro Konoye remained the guiding principle of Japanese policy toward China, a Japanese Embassy spokesman declared yesterday when questioned regarding a purported agreement between Mr. Wang Ching-wei and Japan.

The questioner pointed out that terms of the alleged accord as "exposed" in Hongkong contravened treaties regarding China to which Japan was a signatory.

The Konoye declaration, the spokesman pointed out, emphasized Japan's intention to preserve China's integrity and respect her independence.

Question Of Indemnity
Referring to the question of indemnity, the spokesman pointed out that the term covered various forms of reparations, some concerning indemnification to the nation and others referring to payment of damages sustained by private individuals and others.

The spokesman said he was not in a position to define which type of indemnity Prince Konoye referred to in the statement of December 22, 1938.

1940年1月23日

陈春圃揭露
高陶指控的空洞本质

汪氏秘书长称，二人所称的协议仅为日本最初提出的要求，而非达成的条款

日本发言人称，近卫声明仍是指导原则

汪精卫先生秘书长陈春圃先生于昨日上午接受中央社采访时，就高宗武先生和陶希圣先生报道的汪先生与日本之间签署的所谓协议一事表示，所公布的仅仅是日本方面提出的要求。

中方提出的反要求，以及汪先生代表与日本代表之间实际达成的条款，被完全忽略；这要么是因为高、陶二人对此不知情，要么是因为他们作为与重庆当局交易的一部分而故意隐瞒。

陈氏宣称，已商定的条款肯定不损害中国的主权和独立。中国人民很快就会认识到，这些条款非但不会扼杀中国的独立，反而将构成两国共存共荣的基础，并为远东的永久和平奠定基础。公布实际条款的时机尚未成熟，而在条款公布之前——顺便指出，这需要谈判双方的同意——陈氏表示，他呼吁中国公众保持耐心，不要轻信造谣者和受雇捣乱分子的话。

近卫声明
日本大使馆发言人在昨日被问及关于汪精卫先生与日本之间所谓协议的提问时宣称，近卫文麿亲王的声明仍然是日本对华政策的指导原则。

提问者指出，在香港“曝光”的所谓协定条款，违反了日本作为签署国的有关中国的条约。

该发言人指出，近卫声明强调日本有意维护中国的完整并尊重其独立。

赔款问题
在提及赔款问题时，该发言人指出，该术语涵盖各种形式的赔偿，有些涉及对国家的赔偿，另一些则指对个人及其他方所受损害的赔付。

该发言人表示，他无法界定近卫亲王在1938年12月22日的声明中所指的是哪种类型的赔款。

January 23, 1940. Morning Translation.

National Herald, Ta Wei Pao, Chinese-American Daily News,
Sin Wan Pao, Shun Pao, Hwa Pao (Hongkong telegram) :-

WANG CHING-WEI'S DEMANDS TO THE JAPANESE DISCLOSED BY
KAO CHUNG-WOO

In the latter part of August last year, Wang
Ching-wei submitted to the Japanese authorities a document
entitled "Advice to the Japanese Authorities Prior to the
Establishment of the New Government", which was taken to
Japan by Chow Fu-hai. It contains six conditions. In the
middle of October last year, a reply was sent by the
Japanese authorities to the above.
Wang Ching-wei's document to the Japanese
authorities reads as follows :-
In view of the approaching inauguration of the
new Central Government, the Chinese authorities hold the
view that the following are the necessary conditions for
the establishment of the new Government; they do not harm
Japanese interests :-
(1) Customs Revenue
The Customs revenue collected has been deposited
with the Yokohama Specie Bank ever since the conclusion
of the Anglo-Japanese Tariff Agreement in May last year.
Up to the present, a sum of $180,000,000 in revenue
collected by the Shanghai Maritime Customs has been deposited
with the Yokohama Specie Bank. Certain foreign loans
and indemnity funds due on January 31, 1939 have been
refunded by the Chungking Government. So, funds for
foreign loans and indemnity due before January, 1939
together with the Customs revenue should be handed back
to the new Central Government.
The Japanese authorities are requested to
approve the following two points :-
(a) Prior to the inauguration of the new Central
Government, please instruct the Yokohama Specie
Bank to lend $40,000,000 of the Customs' revenue.
The money will be refunded after the Government's
establishment.
(b) After the Customs revenue deposited with the
Yokohama Specie Bank has been entirely returned,
the monthly income from it should be sent to the
treasury of the new Central Government. A part of
the money, however, may be deposited with the
Yokohama Specie Bank and the remainder may be
deposited with Chinese banks designated by the
Government.
(2) Consolidated Tax
At present, the Kiangsu-Chekiang-Anhwei
Consolidated Tax Bureau is independent and is not placed
under the "Reformed Government". With the approval of
the Japanese authorities, when the new Central
Government has been formed, the Ministry of Finance
will collect this tax to be sent to the national
treasury.
(3) Salt Tax
The Tung Yuen Company in Central China is a salt
transportation organization managed by the Japanese.

《新闻报》、《申报》、《华报》（香港电）：-

高宗武披露汪精卫对日方的要求

去年八月下旬，汪精卫向日本当局提交了一份题为《在新政府成立前致日本当局的建议书》的文件，该文件由周佛海带往日本。文件中包含六项条件。去年十月中旬，日本当局对此作出了回复。
汪精卫致日本当局的文件内容如下：-
鉴于新的中央政府即将成立，中方认为以下是建立新政府的必要条件；这些条件不会损害日本利益：-
(1) 关税收入
自去年五月英日关税协定签订以来，征收的关税收入一直存入横滨正金银行。截至目前，上海海关征收的税款共计1.8亿美元已存入横滨正金银行。1939年1月31日到期的某些外债及赔款已由重庆政府偿还。因此，1939年1月之前到期的外债及赔款资金，连同关税收入，应移交给新的中央政府。
请日本当局批准以下两点：-
(a) 在新的中央政府成立之前，请指示横滨正金银行从关税收入中借出4,000万美元。该笔款项将在政府成立后归还。
(b) 存入横滨正金银行的关税收入全部返还后，其每月收入应汇至新中央政府的国库。然而，部分资金可存入横滨正金银行，其余部分可存入由政府指定的中国银行。
(2) 统税
目前，苏浙皖统税局独立运作，不隶属于“维新政府”。经日本当局批准，在新的中央政府成立后，财政部将征收此税并上缴国库。
(3) 盐税
华中地区的通源公司是一家由日本人管理的食盐运输机构。

The new Central Government cannot be brought

With the approval of the Japanese, the Yangtze

Searches at railway stations and in the city

and policemen. In making arrests in the city of Nanking,

Japan's Reply

The following reply from Japan was received
in the middle of October :-
(1) Customs Revenue
Regarding the request for a loan of $40,000,000
from the Customs revenue deposited with the Yokohama
Specie Bank to the new Central Government prior to its
formation, arrangements will be made to comply with the
request when the new Government has shown efforts to
improve relations between Japan and China. As a matter
of principle, the new Government should have control
over Customs revenue. Customs revenue in North China
and Inner Mongolia, however, should be placed at the
disposal of the district authorities. The Customs
revenue should, for the time being, still be deposited
with the Yokohama Specie Bank.
(2) Consolidated Tax
There is no objection regarding the collection
of consolidated tax in Kiangsu, Chekiang and Anhwei by
the Ministry of Finance of the new Central Government.
(3) Salt Tax
After its inauguration, the new Central
Government will deal gradually with the collection of
salt tax other than that from North China and Inner
Mongolia.
(4) Yangtze Question
The Japanese authorities are eager to re-open
the Yangtze Valley or at least a section of the valley
at an early date. Under the present circumstances,
however, it is hard to tell the date of re-opening.
(5) Passes on Shanghai-Nanking Line and Searches in Nanking
There is no objection in principle regarding
the suggestions on these two points.

该方不纳税。经日本人批准，关于盐税及其他税收的征收措施，在新中央政府成立后，应恢复至战事爆发前所采用的办法。
除非上述三点得到遵守，否则新中央政府无法成立。
(4) 长江问题
经日本人批准，自上海至南京的长江流域，应在新中央政府成立后的两个月内重新开放。该政府将需要获得英国、法国和美国的承认，而若不重新开放长江，这一目标几乎无法实现。
(5) 沪宁线通行证
沪宁线的通行证应由新中央政府在其成立后签发。
(6) 南京的搜查
南京火车站及南京市内的搜查工作，应由中国宪兵和警察执行。在南京市内实施逮捕时，日本宪兵应寻求中国宪兵的协助。

日本的答复

十月中旬收到来自日本的如下答复：
(1) 关税收入
关于在新中央政府成立之前，向该行借支存于横滨正金银行（Yokohama Specie Bank）的关税收入四千万元的请求，待新政府为改善中日关系作出努力后，将作出安排以满足该请求。原则上，新政府应掌控关税收入。然而，华北及内蒙古地区的关税收入，应交由该地区当局支配。目前，关税收入仍应继续存于横滨正金银行。
(2) 统税
对于由新中央政府财政部在江苏、浙江和安徽征收统税一事，并无异议。
(3) 盐税
新中央政府成立后，将逐步处理除华北及内蒙古地区以外的盐税征收事宜。
(4) 长江问题
日本当局渴望尽早重新开放长江流域，或至少开放该流域的一部分。然而，鉴于当前局势，难以确定重新开放的具体日期。
(5) 沪宁线通行证及南京的搜查
原则上对关于这两点的建议并无异议。

Chinese-American Daily News, Ta Mei Pao, National Herald, Sin
Wan Pao, Shun Pao, Hwa Pao :-

WANG CHING-WEI'S SECRET PACT WITH JAPAN

The general public in Shanghai was very
angry with Wang Ching-wei when they read the text of the
secret pact signed by Wang with the Japanese because the
conditions were far more severe than even the Twenty-One
Demands. Many persons who are in favour of Wang's peace
movement have expressed their great disappointment after
reading this secret pact.
It is reported that certain public bodies
in Shanghai will send a joint telegram to the Chungking
Government announcing their opposition to the secret
agreement.

Appendix 2 of Secret Pact

Hongkong, January 22.
The following is the text of Appendix 2
of the secret pact concluded between Wang Ching-wei and
Japanese officials :-

FILE

Appendix 2 : Readjustment of Relations between
Japan and China

Firstly, with a view to establishing peace
in East Asia, the three countries Japan, China and Manchukuo
should respect and co-operate with one another. In order
to improve friendly relations among the three countries,
every effort should be made to devise ways and means to
bring about mutual aid and close friendship.
(1) That China recognize the State of
Manchukuo, while Japan and Manchukuo respect the territorial
and sovereign rights of China; that the relations of Japan,
China and Manchukuo be readjusted.
(2) That Japan, China and Manchukuo suppress
all political and propaganda activities which are harmful to
the good relations among the three countries.
(3) That Japan, China and Manchukuo adopt
a foreign policy based on the principle of mutual
rapprochement; that in all dealings with a third Power,
nothing must be done that may offend this principle.
(4) That Japan, China and Manchukuo strive
for cultural co-operation and development.
(5) That all advisors appointed by Japan
remain on the Central Government so that they may assist in
the work of reconstruction; that advisors and staff members
be detailed to organs established in certain areas.
(6) That as soon as the maintenance of
good relations among the three countries has been achieved,
Japan consider the return of Foreign Settlements and the
abolition of extraterritoriality.
Secondly, Japan, China and Manchukuo should
co-operate against communism.
(1) That Japan, China and Manchukuo suppress,
in their respective territories, communists and their
organizations and assist one another in the maintenance of
intelligence, publicity, etc. relating to the prevention of
communism.

汪精卫与日本的秘密协定

上海公众在阅读汪精卫与日本签署的秘密协定文本后极为愤怒，因为其条件甚至比“二十一条”更为苛刻。许多支持汪精卫和平运动的人士在阅读该秘密协定后表达了极大的失望。
据悉，上海某些公共团体将向重庆政府发送联合电报，宣布反对该秘密协定。

秘密协定附件二

香港，1月22日。
以下为汪精卫与日本官员缔结的秘密协定附件二的文本：-

档案

附件二：调整日中关系

第一，为了在东亚建立和平，日本、中国和满洲国三国应相互尊重并合作。为了改善三国之间的友好关系，应竭尽全力制定办法以实现互助和紧密友谊。
(1) 中国承认满洲国，而日本和满洲国尊重中国的领土和主权权利；调整日本、中国和满洲国之间的关系。
(2) 日本、中国和满洲国镇压一切有害于三国良好关系的政治和宣传活动。
(3) 日本、中国和满洲国采取基于相互亲善原则的外交政策；在与第三国打交道时，不得做任何可能冒犯此原则的事情。
(4) 日本、中国和满洲国努力进行文化合作与发展。
(5) 日本任命的所有顾问留任中央政府，以便协助重建工作；向在某些地区设立的机构派遣顾问和工作人员。
(6) 一旦实现三国间的良好关系，日本应考虑归还外国租界并废除治外法权。
第二，日本、中国和满洲国应合作反共。
(1) 日本、中国和满洲国在各自领土内镇压共产党人及其组织，并在维护有关防止共产主义的情报、宣传等方面相互协助。

第三，为了互助与防御，日本、中国和满洲国应在互惠原则的基础上努力谋求经济亲善。
(1) 鉴于日本、中国和满洲国开发关税、贸易、航空服务、通讯、气象和测量等资源是主要目标，因此应缔结必要的协定。
(2) 关于华北和蒙古的资源，特别是关于蒙古和西藏资源的开发与处置，中国出于联合防御和经济合作的考虑，应向日本提供一切特别便利；即使在其他地区正在进行资源开发的地方，中国也应向日本提供必要的便利，以促进两国之间的经济亲善。
(3) 关于一般工业企业，日本将向中国提供必要的援助；在农产品方面，日本将帮助中国进行改良并增加产量，从而稳定中国人民的生计。
(4) 日本应向中国提供必要的财政和经济援助。
(5) 应采用适当的关税税则和制度，以促进日本、中国和满洲国之间的贸易；同时，应努力满足日本、中国和满洲国对物资和资本的需求，特别是在华北地区。
(6) 关于中国通讯、气象和测量的发展，日本将提供必要的援助，甚至协助促进

Remarks: (a) The New Central Government to pay

Appendix to the Principles governing the Readjustment
of New Relations between Japan and China

A. - Important points on the readjustment of
relations with the Provisional Government.
(1) The expression "North China," as termed
herein, generally denotes the provinces to the south of the
Great Wall (which is not included) such as Hopei, Shansi,
Shantung and that part of Honan to the north of the
Yellow River.
(2) For the purpose of strengthening national
defence and the finances of Japan and Manchukuo in North
China and on the basis of the readjustment of the new
relations between Japan and China, a North China Political
Council is to be formed.
(3) The question of the formation of the North
China Political Council and its authority are to be
discussed by the Central Political Council and decided by
Wang Ching-wei and Wang Kch-min prior to the creation of
a Central Government.
(4) After the relations between Japan and China
have become normal, the formation of the North China
Political Council will depend on the materialization of
the following items:-
a) Common front against Communism.
1) The handling of affairs arising out of the garrisoning
of Japanese armed forces.
2) The handling of affairs relating to joint efforts
for the suppression of Communism and the maintenance
of peace.
3) The handling of affairs relating to military
co-operation between Japan and China.
b) Economic rapprochement between Japan and China,
particularly the development of untouched resources and
the financial requirements of Japan and Manchukuo in
North China.
1) The development of economic resources and the
according of facilities to this end.
2) The handling of affairs for the reasonable provision
of material and financial requirements and supplies
among Japan, Manchukuo, Mongolia and North China.
3) Joint efforts in the matter of currency and exchange
among Japan, Manchukuo, Mongolia and North China.
4) Joint efforts between Japan and China for the
promotion of airways, railways and coastal
communications.

备注：(a) 新中央政府就“中国事变”中日本政府和人民所遭受的损失支付赔偿金。
(b) 在中日恢复正常关系之前，新中央政府应与日本就所有影响日本的重要事务进行密切磋商。

《调整日中新关系原则》附录

A. - 关于调整与临时政府关系的要点。
(1) 此处所称“华北”，一般指长城以南（不包括长城本身）的省份，如河北、山西、山东以及黄河以北的河南部分地区。
(2) 为加强日本和满洲国在华北的国防及财政，并以调整日中新关系为基础，将成立华北政务委员会。
(3) 华北政务委员会的组建及其权限问题，应在中央政府成立之前，由中央政治委员会讨论，并由汪精卫和王克敏决定。
(4) 中日关系正常化后，华北政务委员会的组建取决于以下事项的落实：-
a) 反共共同战线。
1) 处理因日军驻防而产生的事务。
2) 处理有关联合镇压共产主义和维护和平的事务。
3) 处理有关中日军事合作的事务。
b) 中日经济亲善，特别是未开发资源的开发以及日本和满洲国在华北的财政需求。
1) 开发经济资源并提供便利以实现此目标。
2) 处理日本、满洲国、蒙古和华北之间合理提供物资、财政需求和供应的事务。
3) 在日本、满洲国、蒙古和华北之间的货币和汇兑方面共同努力。
4) 中日共同努力促进航空、铁路和沿海交通的发展。

II. Principal measures for the adjustment of
relations with the "Reformed Government"
A. The position of the "Reformed Government"
should be respected, while efforts should be made to secure
its co-operation and to effect its amalgamation with the
new Central Government so as to enable it to carry out its
political duties prior to the formal inauguration of the
Central Government.
B. Though it is not necessary to establish
a Political Affairs Commission after the formation of the
new Central Government, consideration should, however, be
given to the prestige and position of the leading elements
of the "Reformed Government" by the Wang Ching-wei regime.
C. Pending the formal establishment of the
Central Government and the dissolution of the "Reformed
Government," the former should continue to function de
facto so as to facilitate the smooth transfer of the
administration without giving rise to public excitement.
D. The Japanese demands for Sino-Japanese
economic co-operation along the Lower Yangtze consist of:-
(1) In New Shanghai:
(a) Co-operation in the construction
of a new Shanghai.
(b) The disposal of all affairs of
arising out of the stationing of Japanese garrisons
during the process of the construction of a new Shanghai.
(c) Co-operation in developing
communications facilities, both by sea and along the
Yangtze as well as by air, in new Shanghai.
(d) Co-operation in all other affairs
that are to be dealt with during the construction of a
New Shanghai.
(2) With a view to facilitating compliance
with all these foregoing demands, a Sino-Japanese Economic
Co-operative Discussion Organ should be established and all
necessary arrangements pertaining to its establishment should
be made.

III. Principal measures for the adjustment of
relations with the Autonomous Government of Mongolia
A. The so-called Mongolian territory referred
to in these measures consists of the territory to the north
of the inner Great Wall which is included.
B. Economically and from the viewpoint of
national defence, Mongolia constitutes a special area for
the intensification of co-operation among China, Japan and
Manchukuo. With the exception of its diplomatic affairs
(which do not come within the diplomatic negotiations with
Japan and Manchukuo), the Mongolian Government should be
recognized as an organ having autonomous rights. All
affairs relating to its political, legislative, judicial and
military administration as well as diplomatic negotiations
with Outer Mongolia should be based upon the de facto
situation. In addition, the territory should be recognized
as a strong anti-Communist and Autonomous State.

二、调整与“维新政府”关系之主要措施
A. 应尊重“维新政府”之地位，同时努力争取其合作，并促使其与新中央政府合并，以便在中央政府正式成立之前，使其能够履行政治职责。
B. 虽无必要在新中央政府成立后设立政治事务委员会，但汪精卫政权应考虑“维新政府”领导人物之声望与地位。
C. 在中央政府正式成立及“维新政府”解散之前，前者应继续事实上运作，以利于行政权力平稳移交，避免引起公众骚动。
D. 日本方面就长江下游地区之中日经济合作所提要求如下：
(1) 在新上海：
(a) 合作建设新上海。
(b) 处理在建设新上海过程中因日军驻防而产生之一切事务。
(c) 合作发展新上海之海路、长江水路及航空交通设施。
(d) 合作处理在建设新上海期间需解决之其他一切事务。
(2) 为便于满足上述所有要求，应成立中日经济合作协商机构，并就其成立作出一切必要安排。

三、调整与蒙古自治政府关系之主要措施
A. 本措施所称之所谓蒙古地区，系指包括在内的内长城以北地区。
B. 从经济及国防观点来看，蒙古构成中、日、满三国加强合作之特殊区域。除外交事务（不属于与日本及满洲国之外交谈判范围）外，应承认蒙古政府为拥有自治权之机关。凡涉及其政治、立法、司法及军事管理以及与外蒙古之外交谈判之一切事务，均应以事实情况为依据。此外，该地区应被承认为一个强大之反共自治国家。

C. With a view to stabilizing the relations
between the Federal Autonomous Government of Mongolia and
the new Central Government, the following points must be
put down in black and white during the interview between

(1) That the Central Government recognize

(2) A separate pact should be reached

IV. The Wang Ching-wei Government should
recognize the de facto position of Amoy as a special

V. An administration organ with right to deal
with military affairs should be established on Hainan
Island under the direct control of the Central Government
on the basis of the special position enjoyed by Japan on
that island to look after the following affairs in the
various special designated isles along the coast on South
China:-
(A) Disputes arising out of the stationing
of Japanese garrison troops.
(B) Sino-Japanese co-operation in military
affairs as well as in the maintenance of peace and order.
(C) The development and utilization of
special resources necessary for national defence purposes.
(D) Affairs relating to aviation,
communications and navigation.

Remarks: These measures include all our
demands that should be defined and agreed upon in future
between Japan and China, as well as those relating to the
independent disposal of the question concerning the military
strength of China.

C. 为稳定蒙古联邦自治政府与新中央政府之间的关系，在汪精卫或其代表与德王（Prince Tuh）或其代表举行会晤期间，且在中央政治会议召开之前，必须将下列各点以书面形式明确下来：
(1) 中央政府承认蒙古联邦自治政府为促进其自治及镇压共产主义而采取的事实上的行动。
(2) 双方应达成一项单独协定，以便在新中央政府成立后调整彼此关系。
D. 在上述谅解达成后，蒙古联邦自治政府应委派代表出席中央政治会议。

四、汪精卫政府应承认厦门作为特别行政区的事实地位。
五、鉴于日本在海南岛享有的特殊地位，应在该岛设立一个有权处理军事事务的行政机构，直属于中央政府管辖，以负责处理华南沿海各指定特别岛屿的下列事务：
(A) 因日军驻屯而产生的纠纷。
(B) 中日双方在军事事务以及维持和平与秩序方面的合作。
(C) 开发及利用国防所需的特殊资源。
(D) 与航空、通讯及航海有关的事务。

备注：上述措施涵盖了所有应由中日两国在未来予以界定并商定的我方要求，以及涉及独立处置中国军力问题的相关要求。

Besides this Wang Ching-Wei promised to form twenty divisions of

“汉奸汪精卫的破产”

"TRAITOR WANG CHING-WEI'S BANKRUPTCY"

MOSCOW. October 12. "Pravda" in an article entitled "Traitor Wang Ching-Wei's Bankruptcy" writes, "Wang Ching-Wei's failure is not only his own failure and that of the group of his adherents, but is the defeat of Japanese Imperialism, a defeat which coincided with the serious defeat of the Japanese troops in the vicinity of Changsha. Japanese Imperialism staked very much on Wang Ching-Wei, and to secure that aim, went so far as to convert Wang Ching-Wei, who was their secret agent in the Kuomintang into their open agent. The Japanese failed to reach their aim, i.e. to split the Kuomintang and the Chungking Government. This split was only part of the Japanese plans connected with Wang Ching-Wei. The Japanese Imperialists wished to use Wang Ching-Wei to consolidate a new puppet regime to be created in occupied Chinese territory. Last April Kao Chung Wu, Wang Ching-Wei's personal agent, arrived at Tokyo and handed the former Japanese Premier Hiranuma the text of an agreement with Wang Ching-Wei, composed by the latter himself. This plan first provided for a military program and a further offensive by the Japanese army in Northern, Central and Southern China. In Northern China the Japanese troops were to capture town of Hsian, and the special border zone, the towns Yichang, Changsha and others in Central China and the Towns of Nanning and Kweiling in Southern China. Upon the fulfilment of that program, the Japanese had to launch a general offensive against Chungking, it being assured by Wang Ching-Wei that his secret adherents, would blow up Chiang Kai-shek's Regime from within, Wang Ching-Wei's letter to Hiranuma openly indicating this fact. The entire program was to have been materialised in August 1939, and according to this plan the Japanese were not to conduct any negotiations on peace with Chiang Kai-shek. Wang Ching-Wei promised to immediately form an anti-communist Alliance of National Salvation, and re-organize the Kuomintang according to the Principles of anti-communism, and the expulsion of all anti-Japanese elements supporting Chiang Kai-shek. Besides this Wang Ching-Wei promised to form twenty divisions of puppet troops of Chinese, from his adherents. The Japanese, in their turn promised to pay Wang Ching-Wei three million dollars monthly and granted him four million dollars in advance. Such was the agreement signed by Hiranuma and Wang Ching-Wei who arrived at Tokyo for this purpose. Such was the plan, but the results proved quite different. Firstly the military part of the program failed. It failed at first in Shansi, then in Shantung and Anhwei, and finally shamelessly failed at the Changsha Sector of the Central Front. As to the Political part of the plan it was subjected to the same fate. Not a single division of the 21 promised by Wang Ching-Wei exists. He also did not succeed in forming his peace Kuomintang. All Wang Ching-Wei's intrigues met with determined resistance on the part of the Chinese Peoples, and Wang Ching-Wei's failures alarmed the Japanese. They now fear the complete bankruptcy of Wang Ching-Wei, who has everywhere encountered the hatred of the peoples' masses and honest patriots, but this bankruptcy is already complete." "Traitors like Wang Ching-Wei" says the magazine "Amerasia," "can only be useful when they are isolated from the people under the protection of the Japanese bayonets, but when they attempt to approach the people, they are humiliated and killed as base dogs." "Such is the destiny of the ill-starred traitor Wang Ching-Wei."

(Recd by Fleet Agency 9
Circulated forward by direction
Commander)

“卖国贼汪精卫的破产”

莫斯科，10月12日。《真理报》在一篇题为《卖国贼汪精卫的破产》的文章中写道：“汪精卫的失败不仅是他本人及其追随者集团的失败，也是日本帝国主义的失败，这一失败与日军在长沙附近遭受的严重挫败相吻合。日本帝国主义在汪精卫身上押下了很大的赌注，为了实现这一目标，甚至将身为国民党内部秘密代理人的汪精卫转变为公开代理人。日本人未能达到其目的，即分裂国民党和重庆政府。这种分裂只是日本人与汪精卫有关的计划的一部分。日本帝国主义者希望利用汪精卫来巩固将在被占领的中国领土上建立的新傀儡政权。去年四月，汪精卫的个人代理人高宗武抵达东京，向前日本首相平沼骐一郎递交了由汪精卫亲自拟定的与汪精卫的协议文本。该计划首先规定了一项军事计划，以及日军在中国华北、华中和华南的进一步进攻。在华北，日军要攻占西安城；在华中的特殊边境地带，要攻占宜昌、长沙等城镇；在华南，要攻占南宁和桂林等城镇。在该计划实施后，日军将对重庆发动全面进攻，汪精卫保证其秘密追随者将从内部炸毁蒋介石的政权，汪精卫致平沼的信中公开指出了这一事实。整个计划原定于1939年8月实现，根据该计划，日本人不得与蒋介石进行任何和平谈判。汪精卫承诺立即组建一个反共的救国联盟，并根据反共原则和驱逐所有支持蒋介石的反日分子来改组国民党。此外，汪精卫还承诺从其追随者中组建二十个师的伪军。作为回报，日本人承诺每月支付汪精卫三百万美元，并预付给他四百万美元。这就是平沼和为此目的抵达东京的汪精卫所签署的协议。这就是计划，但结果却截然不同。首先，计划的军事部分失败了。起初在山西失败，然后在山东和安徽失败，最后在中部前线的长沙战区可耻地失败。至于计划的政治部分，也遭遇了同样的命运。汪精卫承诺的二十一个师中，没有一个师存在。他也未能组建他的‘和平’国民党。汪精卫的所有阴谋都遭到了中国人民的坚决抵抗，汪精卫的失败使日本人感到惊慌。他们现在担心汪精卫彻底破产，汪精卫到处遭到人民群众和爱国志士的憎恨，但这种破产已经彻底完成。”《美亚》杂志称：“像汪精卫这样的卖国贼，只有在日本刺刀的保护下与人民隔离时才有用，但当他们试图接近人民时，就会像卑鄙的狗一样受到羞辱并被杀死。”“这就是命运多舛的卖国贼汪精卫的下场。”

（由舰队通讯社9收到
奉指挥官命令转发）
